The proper reading is that prior approval remains context only, and the subgroup weakness must be the central stated limitation in any certification treatment. On that basis, the claim should be narrowed from full compliance to caveated certification or reduced escalation, rather than treated as an attempt to substitute stale approval or informal monitoring for current documentation.
